strings.shop.title: Forest Shop (Zero Pay-to-Win)
strings.shop.subtitle: All purchases are cosmetic or comfort-only. Gameplay balance is 100% fair.
strings.shop.no_ads.name: Remove Ads (No Ads)
strings.shop.no_ads.desc: Permanently disables any non-voluntary/interstitial ad formats and grants 1 free mutation reroll every run without watching video. Optional voluntary rewarded ads (Revive & 2x Essence) remain strictly opt-in at your choice.
strings.shop.fx_starlight.desc: Cosmetic starlight wake particles while moving.
strings.privacy.title: Privacy Policy & App Info
strings.privacy.body:
SLIME RUSH: EVOLUTION works completely offline.

1. Data Collection: We do not collect names, emails, precise location, contacts, or personal identifiers.
2. Analytics: Only with your explicit consent, anonymous gameplay events (run duration, chosen mutations, boss outcomes) are logged to tune game balance. Toggle consent anytime in Settings.
3. Ads & Billing: Voluntary rewarded ads (Google AdMob) and purchases (Google Play Billing) run through official platform SDKs when online.
4. Local Saves: Progression is stored locally on your device.
5. Version: 1.0.0 (Godot 4.5). All visual and audio assets are original.
strings.tut.step1: Drag one finger anywhere in the lower screen area to steer your slime!
strings.tut.step2: Absorb tiny mushrooms and fireflies to grow mass and fill Evolution.
strings.tut.step3: Careful! Armored and larger foes require mutations, stuns, or smart dodging.
strings.tut.step4: Awesome! Pick your first mutation — combining pairs unlocks super synergies!
strings.mut.magnet.name: Magnet
strings.mut.magnet.desc: Pulls essence, spores, and tiny prey inward with a magnetic field.
strings.mut.speed_boost.name: Swiftness
strings.mut.speed_boost.desc: Increases movement speed and agility via streamlined fins.
strings.mut.spikes.name: Spikes
strings.mut.spikes.desc: Crystalline thorns deal contact damage and crack armored shells.
strings.mut.poison_trail.name: Poison Trail
strings.mut.poison_trail.desc: Leaves corrosive pools that damage and weaken pursuers.
strings.mut.split.name: Mitosis Split
strings.mut.split.desc: Buds off a temporary twin clone that distracts foes and gathers prey.
strings.mut.shield.name: Membrane Shield
strings.mut.shield.desc: Energy dome blocks one incoming attack completely with a shockwave.
strings.mut.regeneration.name: Regeneration
strings.mut.regeneration.desc: Accelerates cellular health recovery over time.
strings.mut.dash.name: Jet Dash
strings.mut.dash.desc: High-speed burst forward with brief invulnerability frames.
strings.mut.ranged_absorb.name: Tendril Siphon
strings.mut.ranged_absorb.desc: Extends elastic tendrils to reel in weak or stunned prey from afar.
strings.mut.electro_discharge.name: Electro Discharge
strings.mut.electro_discharge.desc: Periodically zaps nearby enemies with stunning chain lightning.
strings.mut.freeze.name: Frost Pulse
strings.mut.freeze.desc: Chills nearby targets, slowing them and lowering absorption resistance.
strings.mut.mimicry.name: Forest Mimicry
strings.mut.mimicry.desc: Camouflages the slime, shrinking enemy aggro range and boosting ambush strikes.
strings.syn.em_storm.name: Electromagnetic Storm
strings.syn.em_storm.desc: Magnet + Electro Discharge: vortex pulls foes inward into chain lightning.
strings.syn.toxic_clones.name: Toxic Twins
strings.syn.toxic_clones.desc: Poison Trail + Split: spawns 2 virulent clones that explode in acid.
strings.syn.piercing_strike.name: Piercing Strike
strings.syn.piercing_strike.desc: Dash + Spikes: turns Dash into an armor-shattering drill charge.
strings.syn.ice_armor.name: Glacial Armor
strings.syn.ice_armor.desc: Freeze + Shield: breaking the shield freezes all surrounding attackers.
strings.syn.bio_vampirism.name: Biological Vampirism
strings.syn.bio_vampirism.desc: Regeneration + Tendril Siphon: drains health even from larger foes.
strings.enemy.tiny_mushroom.name: Tiny Mushroom
strings.enemy.tiny_mushroom.desc: Peaceful sporeling of mossy clearings. Ideal early meal.
strings.enemy.forest_beetle.name: Forest Beetle
strings.enemy.forest_beetle.desc: Skittish forager that flees rapidly from stronger slimes.
strings.enemy.firefly.name: Firefly
strings.enemy.firefly.desc: Darts in rapid zig-zags. Rich in Evolution energy and Essence.
strings.enemy.stone_slug.name: Stone Slug
strings.enemy.stone_slug.desc: Slow tank with a stone shell. Crack its armor with spikes, lightning, or frost!
strings.enemy.poison_toad.name: Poison Toad
strings.enemy.poison_toad.desc: Hops across trails leaving hazardous toxic puddles behind.
strings.enemy.predator_flower.name: Predator Flower
strings.enemy.predator_flower.desc: Hides in foliage to lunge from ambush, briefly exposing its core afterward.
strings.enemy.electric_beetle.name: Electric Beetle
strings.enemy.electric_beetle.desc: Telegraphs and unleashes a high-voltage radial discharge.
strings.enemy.shadow_slime.name: Shadow Slime
strings.enemy.shadow_slime.desc: Aggressive forest predator that actively hunts the player.
strings.enemy.umbral_alpha.name: Umbral Grove Alpha
strings.enemy.umbral_alpha.desc: Mid-run mini-boss packing lunges and rich Essence rewards.
strings.boss.ancient_guardian.name: Ancient Forest Guardian
strings.boss.ancient_guardian.desc: Colossal spirit of roots and crystals featuring three distinct combat phases.
strings.upg.start_mass.name: Starting Mass
strings.upg.start_mass.desc: Increases initial slime mass at the start of every run.
strings.upg.move_speed.name: Membrane Elasticity
strings.upg.move_speed.desc: Boosts base movement speed and turn responsiveness.
strings.upg.essence_chance.name: Essence Affinity
strings.upg.essence_chance.desc: Increases Essence drop chance and bonus yield.
strings.upg.max_vitality.name: Vitality Reserve
strings.upg.evolution_rate.name: Evolution Catalyst
strings.upg.evolution_rate.desc: Speeds up Evolution XP gain toward mutations.
